content:
We got list of templates. The first one (reaction_id 647549) is amide formation (break amide). Good.

Now we need to apply this template to target to get precursors.

Use apply_template with template_id maybe reaction_id? The tool expects template_id string. The IDs from search are reaction_id numbers. Probably template_id is string of reaction_id. Let's try apply_template with template_id "647549".


{"molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1", "template_id": "647549"}
